title: Build Your AI Marketing Assistant
description: Create a Custom GPT in ChatGPT that acts as your personal marketing assistant — trained on your brand voice, business context, and marketing frameworks.
prerequisites: ChatGPT Plus account (or free account for basic version)
A business idea or brand to build the assistant for
Completed notes on CRAFT framework and buyer personas
learning_outcomes: Understand how to create and configure Custom GPTs
Write effective system instructions for AI assistants
Upload knowledge files to improve AI responses
Test and iterate on AI assistant behavior
Share your Custom GPT with others

steps.title: Set Up Your Custom GPT
steps.instructions:
1. Go to chat.openai.com and click on 'Explore GPTs' in the sidebar.
2. Click 'Create' to start building your Custom GPT.
3. Give it a name: '[YourBrand] Marketing Assistant' (e.g., 'Chai pe Charcha Marketing Bot').
4. Write a short description: 'A marketing assistant trained to help [business name] create social media content, write ad copy, and plan campaigns for [target audience] in [city].'
5. Upload a profile picture — use Canva to create a simple logo or icon for your bot.
6. Choose the conversation style: select 'More creative' for marketing content generation.

Note: If you are on the free plan, you can simulate this exercise by creating a detailed system prompt in a regular ChatGPT conversation and saving it in a document for reuse.

steps.title: Define Instructions and Brand Context
steps.instructions:
1. In the 'Instructions' field, write a detailed system prompt. Use this template:

---
You are the marketing assistant for [Business Name], a [business type] located in [city, India].

Brand Voice: [describe — e.g., friendly, youthful, uses Hinglish]
Target Audience: [describe your primary buyer persona]
Products/Services: [list main offerings with prices in ₹]
Competitors: [list 2-3 competitors]
Goals: [what the business wants to achieve]

When creating content:
- Always use simple language that a college student would understand
- Include Indian cultural references and festivals where relevant
- Use the CRAFT framework for all outputs
- Follow the 4-1-1 rule for social media content suggestions
- Mention prices in ₹ (Indian Rupees)
- Suggest hashtags relevant to the Indian market
---

2. Add 3-5 specific rules (e.g., 'Never use American spellings', 'Always suggest posting times in IST', 'Include at least one Hindi word or phrase in captions').
3. Preview by sending a test message and checking if the bot follows your instructions.

steps.title: Add Knowledge Files
steps.instructions:
1. Prepare 2-3 knowledge documents to upload:
   - Document 1: Your buyer personas (from Assignment Task 2)
   - Document 2: Your brand guidelines (name, colors, voice, dos and don'ts)
   - Document 3: A list of your products/services with descriptions and pricing

2. Create these as simple .txt or .pdf files. Example for Document 2:
   - Brand Name: Chai pe Charcha
   - Tagline: 'Where every cup starts a conversation'
   - Colors: Warm orange (#FF6B35), Cream (#FFF5E1)
   - Voice: Friendly, funny, uses Hinglish, references Bollywood
   - Do: Use local Bhopal references, mention student discounts
   - Don't: Be formal, use complex English, ignore festivals

3. Upload all files in the 'Knowledge' section of your Custom GPT.
4. In the instructions, add: 'Refer to the uploaded knowledge files for brand-specific information before generating any content.'
5. Test by asking: 'Write an Instagram caption for our new monsoon special chai' — the response should match your brand voice.

steps.title: Test with Real Marketing Tasks
steps.instructions:
1. Test your Custom GPT with these 5 marketing scenarios:

   Test 1 — Social Media: 'Write 3 Instagram captions for our Raksha Bandhan special offer'
   Test 2 — Ad Copy: 'Write a Facebook ad promoting our new cold coffee for college students'
   Test 3 — Email: 'Write a WhatsApp broadcast message for our loyalty customers about 20% off'
   Test 4 — Strategy: 'Suggest 5 content ideas for this week based on trending topics'
   Test 5 — Response: 'A customer complained about slow service on Google Reviews. Draft a reply.'

2. For each test, evaluate:
   - Did it follow the brand voice? (Yes/No)
   - Did it use Indian context? (Yes/No)
   - Was the output usable without major editing? (Yes/No)
   - Rate quality: 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent)

3. Fill in this scorecard in a document.
4. If any test scored below 3, refine your instructions and test again.
5. Make note of what changes improved the output (this is prompt engineering in action).

steps.title: Share and Document Your Assistant
steps.instructions:
1. Once satisfied with your Custom GPT's performance, click 'Save' and choose sharing settings:
   - 'Only me' — for personal use
   - 'Anyone with a link' — to share with classmates or the business owner
   - 'Public' — if you want it discoverable by others

2. Create a documentation page (Google Doc or Notion) with:
   - Assistant Name and Purpose
   - Link to the Custom GPT
   - Instructions you used (copy-paste)
   - Knowledge files list
   - 5 best prompts that work well with your assistant
   - 3 limitations you discovered (things it gets wrong or needs human review)

3. Record a 2-minute screen recording showing:
   - Opening your Custom GPT
   - Giving it a marketing task
   - Showing the output
   - Explaining one refinement you made

4. Share the documentation and recording link with your trainer.

Bonus: Create a second Custom GPT for a different business type (e.g., if you did a cafe, try a coaching institute) and compare how different instructions produce different outputs.
